# Security policy

_dreamcatcher_ runs `gh`, `claude` and `codex` signed in as you, so a
vulnerability in it can act as you.

## Report a vulnerability

Report a vulnerability through GitHub's
[private reporting form](https://github.com/alimanfoo/dreamcatcher/security/advisories/new).
A report there stays private.

Don't report a vulnerability in a discussion, because anyone can read a
discussion.

## What to expect

_dreamcatcher_ is shared, not supported. The project promises no reply
to a report, and no fix within any time.
